from: September book, night 27 (This Is the Way)
p1: Many people in Isaiah’s day did not want to listen. They told the prophets, “Do not tell us what is right.”
But the Lord still loved them. Isaiah said the Lord was waiting, ready to be kind to them.
When you cry out to the Lord, Isaiah said, “He will answer you.”
p2: Isaiah said, “Your ears shall hear a word behind you.” It says, “This is the way, walk ye in it.” Picture a kind grown-up just behind you, saying, “Go this way!”
The Lord helps you know the way through prophets and the Holy Ghost. Listen for that quiet voice inside you. Then walk His way, one step at a time.
old: Isaiah shared a comforting message about how Heavenly Father helps us know which way to go.
“When you’re not sure which way to turn,” Isaiah said, “you will hear a gentle voice behind you saying, ‘This is the way — walk in it.’”
Heavenly Father helps guide us, like a kind whisper in our hearts showing us the right path — the good and safe way to go.
Isaiah also said that being quiet and calm helps us hear Him. “In quietness and trust is your strength,” he taught. When we get still, we can feel Heavenly Father’s gentle guidance.
Whenever you don’t know what’s right, you can get quiet, listen with your heart, and trust Heavenly Father to whisper, “This is the way.” He always helps you find the good path.
